description: HPO phenotype frequencies for FARIMPD and the complete published case tally
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests

r = requests.get("https://ontology.jax.org/api/network/annotation/OMIM:619602", timeout=60).json()
rows=[]
for cat, items in r["categories"].items():
    for it in items:
        f = it["metadata"].get("frequency","")
        n = d = np.nan
        if "/" in f: n, d = [int(x) for x in f.split("/")]
        rows.append({"cat":cat,"hpo":it["id"],"term":it["name"],"n":n,"d":d,
                     "pct":(n/d*100 if d==d and d else np.nan)})
H=pd.DataFrame(rows).dropna(subset=["pct"]).sort_values("pct")

# reported case series assembled from the literature
cases = pd.DataFrame([
 {"report":"Chatron 2019 (PMID 31608932)","families":2,"cases":4,"variant":"homozygous nonsense","outcome":"lethal"},
 {"report":"Monteiro 2020 (PMID 30690204)","families":2,"cases":3,"variant":"biallelic LoF","outcome":"neonatal death"},
 {"report":"Furukawa 2024 (PMID 37870493)","families":1,"cases":1,"variant":"missense + nonsense","outcome":"survived neonatal period"},
])
print(cases.to_string(index=False))
print("TOTAL reported:", cases["cases"].sum(), "patients from", cases["families"].sum(), "families")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(13,4.6), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.5,1]})
ax=axes[0]
cols = {"Nervous System":"#C44E52","Prenatal and Birth":"#4C72B0","Clinical course":"#55A868",
        "Head and neck":"#8172B2","Connective tissue":"#CCB974"}
ax.barh(range(len(H)), H["pct"], color=[cols.get(c,"#999999") for c in H["cat"]])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(H)))
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{t}  ({h})" for t,h in zip(H["term"],H["hpo"])], fontsize=9)
for i,(p,n,d) in enumerate(zip(H["pct"],H["n"],H["d"])):
    ax.text(p+1.5, i, f"{int(n)}/{int(d)}", va="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,118); ax.set_xlabel("frequency among annotated patients (%)")
ax.set_title("HPO annotations for OMIM:619602 / MONDO:0859204\n(source PMID 31608932)")

ax=axes[1]
b=ax.bar(cases["report"].str.split(" \(").str[0], cases["cases"], color=["#C44E52","#C44E52","#4C72B0"])
for i,(c,f) in enumerate(zip(cases["cases"],cases["families"])):
    ax.text(i, c+0.08, f"{c} cases\n{f} families", ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("reported patients"); ax.set_ylim(0,5.2)
ax.set_title("All published FARIMPD patients (n=8 from 5 families)")
plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=20, ha="right", fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
